name: field-equipment-status-tracker
description: Runs the backend and frontend together. Each app also works on its own from its folder.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:reset
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
